Graham Hancock, the writer known for arguing that a lost advanced culture shaped the ancient world, is the subject of this clip from Joe Rogan Experience episode 360. The segment centers on his TED talk and the fight that followed when TED pulled the video from its main site.

Hancock and Rogan discuss why the talk on psychedelics and consciousness caused such a storm. They argue the removal was censorship of ideas that challenge mainstream science. Rogan defends Hancock's right to make his case in public. The clip captures an early chapter of Hancock's long run as Rogan's most debated history guest.
